name: Navbar
description: Responsive sticky navbar with logo, links, a coral CTA, and an animated mobile hamburger menu that elevates on scroll.
usage: React: import Navbar from './Navbar' and render <Navbar /> at the top of your layout; override brand, links, ctaLabel/ctaHref, and secondaryLabel/secondaryHref via props. HTML: paste section.html (including its <script>) at the top of your <body>; it needs Tailwind and handles the hamburger toggle, scroll elevation, and Escape-to-close on its own.
